articles.title: Papa León XIV sigue su recuperación en El Vaticano y presidirá el miércoles la audiencia general
articles.summary: Papa León XIV sigue su recuperación en El Vaticano y presidirá el miércoles la audiencia general
articles.body_text: León XIV, operado la pasada semana de un tumor canceroso en el pulmón, sigue su recuperación en el Palacio Apostólico vaticano y el próximo miércoles volverá a celebrar la habitual Audiencia General en la Plaza de San Pedro, informaron fuentes de la oficina de prensa de la Santa Sede. El pontífice permanecerá en El Vaticano, según las citadas fuentes, y no se desplazará esta semana a la localidad de Castelgandolfo -a unos 30 kilómetros de Roma- como solía hacer antes de su operación para descansar la tarde del lunes y el martes. articles.title: Incendios forestales en Cusco: cifra de fallecidos se eleva a ocho
articles.summary: Los incendios forestales en Cusco dejaron ocho fallecidos, luego del hallazgo de un cuerpo calcinado en la provincia de Espinar, cuya identidad aún debe ser confirmada por las autoridades.
articles.body_text: La cifra de fallecidos por los incendios forestales en Cusco se elevó a ocho tras el hallazgo del cuerpo calcinado de un hombre de 34 años en la provincia de Espinar. La víctima sería un pastor que permanecía desaparecido desde el incendio que afectó la zona durante el último fin de semana, aunque las autoridades aún deben confirmar su identidad. Los restos fueron encontrados por comuneros en el sector de Chipta, perteneciente a la comunidad campesina de Ccahuaya, en Alto Pichigua, Espinar. El hombre, identificado como Frank Morales, era buscado por los pobladores desde que se reportó su desaparición tras el siniestro. Según la información disponible, los familiares habrían reconocido parcialmente el cuerpo. Sin embargo, corresponde a las autoridades determinar si los restos pertenecen efectivamente al hombre desaparecido. De acuerdo con el Centro de Operaciones de Emergencia Regional (COER) Cusco, hasta la fecha se han registrado 371 incendios forestales en la región, que afectaron aproximadamente 13.300 hectáreas. El reporte de la Oficina Regional de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres y Seguridad del Gobierno Regional de Cusco, difundido el miércoles 21 de octubre, confirmó que el número de fallecidos por estas emergencias ascendió a ocho. Asimismo, el informe indicó que, de los ocho incendios reportados hasta ese día en las provincias de Calca, Chumbivilcas, Anta, La Convención y Canchis, dos permanecían sin ser liquidados. La información proporcionada menciona a Anta en dos ocasiones al detallar las zonas afectadas. Según los reportes sobre el caso, el hombre hallado en Espinar trabajaba como pastor en la zona y tenía una condición médica especial que le habría dificultado escapar de las llamas. Tras el incendio, sus familiares perdieron sus pertenencias y solicitaron ayuda estatal para cubrir los gastos del sepelio y entierro.

articles.title: Senamhi alerta sobre lluvias intensas en Arequipa y Moquegua desde este jueves 22 de octubre
articles.summary: El aviso de nivel rojo afectará siete provincias de Arequipa y dos de Moquegua desde las 5:00 p.m. de este jueves hasta el mediodía del sábado 24 de octubre.
articles.body_text: El Servicio Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología del Perú (Senamhi) emitió una alerta meteorológica de nivel rojo por la llegada de lluvia de extrema intensidad en las regiones de Arequipa y Moquegua desde este jueves 22 de octubre. Este fenómeno iniciaría desde las 5:00 p.m. del jueves con una vigencia temporal estimada de 43 horas continuas en la costa sur del país. El reporte de Senamhi detalla que los mayores niveles de acumulación de agua en el departamento de Arequipa ocurrirán el mismo jueves 22 de octubre con registros de 2.5 mm por día. Por su parte, el territorio de Moquegua soportará sus marcas pluviométricas más elevadas durante la jornada del viernes 23 de octubre con volúmenes acumulados que alcanzarán los 3 mm por día. El ámbito de cobertura del aviso oficial abarca un total de siete provincias en la región arequipeña y dos jurisdicciones en el área moqueguana. Las provincias bajo monitoreo en Arequipa son Arequipa, Camaná, Caravelí, Castilla, Caylloma, Condesuyos e Islay, en tanto que la alerta en Moquegua comprende a Ilo y Mariscal Nieto. Las precipitaciones pluviales llegarán junto con el aumento sostenido en la velocidad del viento y una densa cobertura de nubes cerca de la franja costera del sur. Este fenómeno atmosférico provocará la presencia constante de niebla y neblina durante las noches, madrugadas y primeras horas de la mañana, lo cual aumentará la sensación de frío en la población. El Instituto Nacional de Defensa Civil (Indeci) recomienda las autoridades regionales y locales la inspección inmediata de las rutas de evacuación ante el peligro de deslizamientos. El organismo preventivo solicita verificar la disponibilidad operativa de los centros de salud, las compañías de bomberos y las comisarías para atender cualquier emergencia. La institución de prevención exhortó a las familias a reforzar las estructuras de los techos de sus viviendas ante la llegada de las lluvias de nivel peligroso. Los ciudadanos organizarán la implementación de sistemas comunitarios de alerta temprana mediante el empleo de silbatos, campanas y sirenas en las zonas vulnerables.

articles.title: Próximos feriados 2026: ¿Cuántos feriados quedan y qué se celebra en el Perú?
articles.summary: Conoce el calendario oficial de feriados en Perú para 2026 y revisa qué días libres quedan en los últimos meses del año. Consulta las fechas de noviembre y diciembre para planificar tus viajes, actividades familiares o próximos descansos.
articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.title: The internet is having a very bad cybersecurity day | TechCrunch
articles.summary: From AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities to flaws in Node.js and popular AI tool LiteLLM, cybersecurity teams have plenty to worry about this week.
articles.body_text: The internet is having a bad day, from a cybersecurity perspective. Government websites around the world went offline , Reuters reported, after AI discovered critical security vulnerabilities that impacted the programming language PHP . The issues were severe enough that the U.S. National Security Agency (NSA) advised organizations using PHP on their systems to either immediately update or take their systems offline until they could. But the PHP update wasn’t the only headache cybersecurity folks were facing on Wednesday. Node.js , the open-source JavaScript runtime environment, also dropped a security surprise of its own when it shared that four high-severity vulnerabilities were just patched in its latest release. One allowed remote code execution, and two others would have permitted a TLS validation bypass, potentially allowing attackers to bypass checks intended to verify a server’s identity. In addition, LiteLLM, a popular open source proxy for routing requests to multiple LLM providers, was compromised by an attacker who injected malicious code, the company shared in a post on X on Wednesday afternoon. The malicious artifacts were published to PyPI (Python Package Index), Docker Hub , and GHCR (GitHub Container Registry), the post noted. The malicious code was said to include an information stealer that targeted cloud credentials, passwords, and AI service credentials, in addition to a remote access trojan that could allow hackers to execute commands on compromised systems. LiteLLM said it has now removed the malicious releases and images and advised anyone who installed them to follow the remediation guidance it provided. And wait, there’s more! An Indian certificate authority, eMudhra, had its private keys compromised , potentially allowing attackers to issue fraudulent certificates and impersonate legitimate websites. Security pros have called this a massive cleanup job and one that’s “bigger than Heartbleed .” (The latter is a reference to the critical security vulnerability in the OpenSSL cryptographic software library). These issues come on the heels of other security breaches and hacks, including the breach of the cloud-native database-as-a-service, TiDB Cloud, which the company announced on Monday. Other hackers have been exploiting four patched Plex Media Server flaws, collectively called Plex2Shell. And last week, cybersecurity company BeyondTrust warned customers to patch a critical zero-day in its Remote Support product, which had been exploited since August. Though the issues were unrelated to each other, their back-to-back arrival highlights the challenges cybersecurity teams now face. articles.title: GM is giving OnStar an AI makeover | TechCrunch
articles.summary: It's one of the biggest overhauls ever to the 30-year-old connected car product.
articles.body_text: General Motors is adding a personal AI assistant to OnStar as part of a broader makeover of the subscription-based connected car service that the U.S. automaker launched 30 years ago. The OnStar AI Assistant will debut in the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq EV in the coming months, with more GM vehicles to follow, the company said Wednesday at its GM Forward event in New York, where it made a series of other technology announcements covering software, automated driving, EVs, and its electrical architecture. The company said it will launch a new OnStar mobile app in 2027 that will complement and sync up with its in-car software. The new OnStar mobile app will replace the current OnStar Guardian app that launched in 2020 as well as vehicle brand apps for Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, and GMC. This tech-centric reboot is unlike other attempts to modernize OnStar and it notably puts agentic AI at the center. The company has updated the safety and roadside assistance service numerous times in its history, especially in the past five years as it tried to stay apace of emerging and tech-forward competitors like Tesla. In 2021, the company expanded its OnStar Guardian app, which offered crash detection, emergency assistance and location sharing, to anyone with a compatible phone, even if they didn’t own a GM vehicle. A year later, GM started using Google Cloud’s conversational AI Dialogflow to recognize specific spoken requests and expanded in 2023 to give drivers responses to common queries like routing and navigation assistance — all part of GM’s plan to build a $25 billion subscription business by 2030 . GM continued to focus on generative AI, but relied on Google to provide the experience. The company said last year that Google Gemini would roll out in vehicles in 2026. The OnStar AI Assistant is an in-house effort and one aimed at giving the driver and passengers an interactive and custom experience — and become even more embedded in their daily lives. “OnStar is now transitioning to be a connected intelligence platform, not just the call center that it’s historically been known as, but a mechanism for interpreting, understanding, and providing predictive, proactive support to its owners,” GM’s VP of global product and chief product officer Sterling Anderson told TechCrunch in an interview ahead of the GM Forward event. For instance, cameras on the vehicle will be connected to the software to offer live views as well as crash and safety recordings. Users can set up the connected cameras to turn on automatically if the vehicle senses an impending event — for instance an aggressive horn honk — then capture the event and upload it to the OnStar app. Users will be able to use voice to control certain functions on the vehicle, including climate, and ask questions about any specific vehicle feature. The launch coincides with efforts throughout the auto industry to stay apace of Chinese automakers with technology that is central to the vehicle — and no longer a slapped on gimmick or feature. But that has required GM to change its approach to software development, adopt AI tools, and even design a new electrical and centralized compute vehicle architecture. The announcement also comes after GM has been criticized and even fined for sharing data with third parties. Earlier this year, the Federal Trade Commission finalized an order that bans General Motors and its OnStar telematics service from sharing certain consumer data with consumer reporting agencies. The finalized order also requires the automaker to be more transparent with its consumers and obtain their explicit consent on certain data collection. GM said Wednesday that customers will have the ability to decide what data is shared, and that the recordings have time limits and are encrypted. GM said it and OnStar cannot access Connected Camera recordings.

articles.title: PHP armageddon: OpenAI, Google's Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet | TechCrunch
articles.summary: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.
articles.body_text: The U.S. National Security Agency’s sent out an alarming warning on Wednesday that two critical holes had been found in PHP, with patches already issued by the PHP Foundation . PHP is a server-side programming language so widely used for web applications that it powers roughly 70% of the websites on the internet; by some accounts, that’s more than 33 million sites . It is also used by popular content management systems like WordPress. The NSA warned that these holes are so severe that if a website can’t be patched immediately, it should be pulled off the web until it can be. The holes allow attackers to infiltrate the server’s file system or a database that may be used by the web app. Interestingly, these holes have been tucked away in all versions of PHP since version 5, which was released in 2004. Websites not running relatively current versions of PHP will have some updating work to do, as PHP 8.1 and older versions are no longer supported. The recommendation is to update the web server to the current version of PHP, which is 8.5.12. So how did two such ubiquitous, decades-old flaws that affect nearly every website on the internet suddenly come to light? AI, naturally, particularly via OpenAI and Google’s Wiz. Security testing company Calif was engaged in OpenAI’s “Patch the Planet” initiative to find flaws in open-source source software. Using GPT‑5.6 Sol, it found one of the flaws, OpenAI disclosed in a blog post . Separately, the Wiz team also used AI, namely its Wiz Atlas security AI agent, Gemini 4 Argon, and GPT-5.6 Sol to find multiple vulnerabilities in PHP. Both OpenAI and Wiz followed responsible security research practices and worked with PHP on patches before publicly disclosing the flaws. Then they all worked together to flesh out what they found, and test the patches, drawing in a host of others to help. Wiz thanked Automattic, Akamai, AWS, Cloudflare, Fastly, Imperva, Microsoft, and Vercel. (While WordPress sites use PHP, WordPress has issued a statement saying that the flaw isn’t WordPress specific, and sites running its CMS must patch their servers and work with their web-hosting companies to ensure their sites are protected.) OpenAI says that these flaws were found by researchers before hackers discovered them. So there were no reports of exploits in the wild. This is also in part because, before AI, these flaws were too hard for hackers to exploit. “With AI this is no longer a barrier. LLMs can help adapt an exploit to different PHP versions, configurations and memory layouts,” Wiz warned in its blog about the flaws. In other words, this is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented because of AI, but is also a high risk only because of AI. Now that the issue has been disclosed, hackers are fully in the know. The race is on for the internet to patch tens millions of websites before hackers can attack the unpatched ones. Hence the NSA’s guidance that if you can’t patch your PHP website right away, you’re better off pulling it offline until you can. articles.body_text: Last month, advertising company Infillion acquired location-data platform Foursquare, a once popular social network, at an undisclosed value. To our ~1600 former employees over 17 years, I am sorry the Foursquare story ended in such a way that makes it seem like our collective efforts were worth … nothing?” he said in the post. Crowley blamed the final outcome on that transition, saying that the management of the company wasn’t able to preserve or create new value. Foursquare, which had raised over $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, eventually shut down its app in 2024 . articles.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it's mostly a headache for now | TechCrunch
articles.summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.
articles.body_text: Companies are giving employees AI tools to make them more productive, but the tools appear to be creating new problems for their managers. More than half of senior leaders say they find it harder to evaluate employees’ work after adopting AI, according to a Nielsen survey of 1,700 directors and senior managers across seven countries, commissioned by work-management company Monday.com. The reason is that much of employees’ output now arrives polished in the manager’s inbox, making it hard to tell how much came from the employee and how much from AI. As a result, nearly half of managers say they spend more time reviewing and guiding their teams’ output than they used to. That’s not to say managers are unhappy about AI. Quite the opposite, in fact: 94% of the managers polled said they were excited to improve work using AI, and many are confident they know where to use it to get the most value. Michal Miller Levi, head of market research and customer insights at Monday.com, compared the enthusiasm to the early days of the internet in the 2000s, saying people see a similar kind of “magic” to AI. But the problem, she told TechCrunch, is simply that AI is developing faster than companies can adapt. “AI works very well for [managers] individually, but they also have a different role as managers. They need to drive the organization as well … Their struggle is [due to] the fact that AI is just moving faster than the organizational processes,” Levi said. Managers are also reconsidering how they judge their teams: 78% of respondents said they have changed how they evaluate employees after adopting AI, placing greater weight on how well staff can create prompts, decide which tasks to delegate to AI, and experiment with new ways of working. But how fairly can employees be judged when managers can’t easily tell how much of their work was produced by AI? And what if the managers themselves are increasingly relying on AI to make those judgments? The survey found that 46% of managers use AI to help inform their decisions, and 39% of leaders are using AI to draft performance reviews. That practice runs the risk of introducing even more bias than usual into the review process, given that LLMs are, at their core, prediction machines and tend to repeat human patterns found in their training data. Research from the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research earlier this year found that “in the absence of clear objective standards and when individuals are rated independently,” LLMs tend to rate performance similarly to humans. And a research paper in early 2025 found that AI models can be biased against black male candidates, and “demonstrate significant biases, varying in terms of the directions and magnitudes across different social groups.” When I asked Levi whether using AI to weigh in on people’s performance could introduce outside bias into the process, she said companies have yet to work out how to handle such issues. AI is also changing what a manager’s day looks like. Someone has to decide which tasks to hand over to AI agents, check what they produce, and step in when something goes wrong. The report suggests that this supervision could amount to a new layer of “invisible labor.” The software itself is becoming harder to manage. Fifty-seven percent of managers say their organizations now have more tools in circulation than before, and about 51% said their tools had grown more interdependent and clustered since adopting AI. Only 29% described their AI infrastructure as fully optimized and centralized. Levi said businesses had expected AI to help shrink their software stacks. Instead, they’re dealing with more apps, integrations, and shadow AI usage as employees adopt tools outside their companies’ approved systems. “Managers completed 2025 with the feeling that they will consolidate tools, actually, that they’ll reduce the number of software. But what happened is that the number of tools that they’re using increased,” Levi said. “More than 50% are saying that they’re using more tools now than they did last year, and it’s not stopping.”

articles.title: Exclusive: Heat pump tech is 170 years old — Pascal thinks it’s time for an update | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Refrigerants startup Pascal has a new take on heat pump and cooling tech using a sponge-like material that promises to be 20% more efficient.
articles.body_text: When the experimental results came back, they puzzled Adam Slavney and Jinyoung Seo. They had been testing a new class of materials for more efficient refrigerators, air conditioners, and heat pumps, a mission that the cooling appliance industry has been on for eons. The measurements for the materials that the team was testing shouldn’t have been different, but they were. “Why are these things different? What did we change?” Slavney told TechCrunch. “We had an inkling of it within three-ish months, but we didn’t have definitive proof for a year or two.” That proof is now underpinning Slavney’s startup, Pascal , where he’s co-founder and CEO and Seo is co-founder and CTO. The company recently raised $8.5 million in a follow-on to its seed round, co-led by Sazze Partners and LB Investment with participation from KDB Silicon Valley, the company exclusively told TechCrunch. A refrigerator or heat pump using Pascal’s material promises to be around 20% more efficient than existing models, he said. (Both heat pumps and refrigerators use the same basic technology.) The startup has signed a contract with a multinational beverage company for a pilot of the technology. “This whole funding round came together originally because we got a customer contract earlier than we were expecting to,” Slavney said. Pascal is on track to deliver its first prototype early next year, and it hopes to follow that with a batch of more polished refrigerators in 2028. Scientists have been searching for better refrigerants for almost as long as refrigerators have existed. More recently, they’ve been looking for compounds that don’t harm the atmosphere in one way or another. They exist, but they also need to be at least as effective as existing refrigerants. “We’ve been playing whack-a-mole with refrigerants for 35 years, 40 years,” Slavney said. Older gaseous refrigerants like Freon ate a hole in the ozone layer, while newer ones like R-134a are still extremely potent greenhouse gases. “It’s just a never-ending treadmill,” he said. One alternative that has attracted researchers’ attention is a class of materials known as solid-state refrigerants. Because they’re solid, they can’t escape to the atmosphere, eliminating the climate and ozone concerns that haunt modern refrigerants. Solid-state refrigerants promise to make refrigerators and heat pumps more efficient. They work similarly to traditional refrigerants, giving off heat when squeezed and absorbing it when that pressure is released. Before his serendipitous discovery, Slavney and his colleagues at Harvard University had been researching the materials. “We wanted to do some high-pressure measurements, and the instrument that we were using required us to use gas. So we used the gas and then we swapped to a different gas and we were like, why are these different?” Slavney said. After numerous additional experiments, the team realized they had discovered another path toward solid-state refrigeration. Rather than squeeze a solid block of material, Pascal’s heat pumps compress a gas — carbon dioxide — into a cartridge that contains a sponge-like material, which Slavney said is proprietary. As the carbon dioxide works its way into the porous material, the gas molecules inside the pores start bouncing off the walls. Those collisions transfer energy to the material, warming it up. A heat exchanger then exhausts some of that heat. Run it in reverse and the material absorbs energy from the heat exchanger and transfers it to the carbon dioxide molecules. In a Pascal refrigerator, two cartridges are running at any given time. One is absorbing heat from the inside of the refrigerator, transferring it to the carbon dioxide, while the other takes the heat from the carbon dioxide and transfers it to the outside air. Eventually, the cartridges become too hot and too cold, so the flow gets reversed.

articles.title: Mach9 raises $34M after pivoting to AI CAD software | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The startup initially set out to build better, faster, and cheaper surveying hardware in 2021.
articles.body_text: When Alex Baikovitz co-founded Mach9 Robotics in 2021, his goal was to build a better, faster, and cheaper way for civil engineers to do visual inspections. The company aimed to cut through red tape and modernize the slow, outdated processes that bog down construction in the United States. Within a few years, Mach9 Robotics had built that hardware, but the effort led Baikovitz to a realization: Hardware wasn’t the bottleneck. “We saw how tedious it was for civil engineering organizations to take data from these amazing laser scanners and image data capture systems and turn that into a usable survey,” he told TechCrunch in an interview, referring to a detailed map of a site that engineers use for design work. “The real pain was in their workflows,” he said, and “how to turn all the endless amounts of data that they’re able to collect into … information that people can use to make the best design and asset management decisions across the board.” So Baikovitz dropped “Robotics” from the company’s name and pivoted to developing AI-powered computer-aided design (CAD) software instead. The bet paid off, as Mach9 has racked up nearly 100 customers for the private beta of its software, and they’ve used it on more than 2,500 projects to date. That momentum helped Mach9 unlock new funding. On Wednesday, the startup announced a $34 million Series A funding round co-led by First Round Capital and Bessemer Venture Partners. Also throwing in were Prudence, an early-stage, New York-based firm that focuses on investing in AI software use cases for construction and real estate, and Quiet Capital, a VC firm already on the cap table. Mach9 is one of several startups racing to modernize the planning-to-building pipeline for construction and infrastructure. In August, a startup called CivilGrid raised $26 million to grow what it calls the “Google Maps for the underground.” Meanwhile, Blueprints AI , which uses AI to produce code-compliant, permit-ready architectural blueprints in just a few minutes, was among the top 200 companies in the Startup Battlefield competition at last week’s TechCrunch Disrupt . Baikovitz said Mach9 is focused on disrupting CAD software because it’s one of the slowest and most labor-intensive pieces of that overall pipeline. “It takes months to be able to deliver a project, and about a week per mile for someone to do manually in the legacy incumbent software that’s built by the Autodesk and Bentley Systems of the world,” he said. Mach9 says its software automates a lot of that work, making the process 10x faster and dramatically reducing costs. This allows customers doing surveying and civil engineering work to “expand their own capacity and take on more types of work, bigger projects, and expand the reach of how reality-capture data can influence major infrastructure decisions,” Baikovitz said. Baikovitz said Mach9 developed and trained its own in-house AI models to reach the centimeter-accurate level that construction and infrastructure work requires. “That’s not something that a lot of off-the-shelf models are able to do or deliver at in any capacity,” he said. “A big part of what our development process has looked like since 2024 has been, how do we build the industry leading models that can turn imagery or these multimodal image and laser scan datasets into survey grade like geometry, like tracing out the curbs, the pavement striping, all of this exactly how our customers want it to be at the accuracies that the industry demands.” Mach9’s AI CAD system takes the survey data and creates a first draft of a plan, which engineers can then refine. The startup is “giving them all of the tools to draw, remove, adjust vertices, assess the quality of the AI-generated model, so that they can put effectively their name behind the deliverable that they’re producing, because there is a lot of liability in this particular industry, and it requires licensed professionals that know what they’re looking at,” Baikovitz said.

articles.body_text: In the spring of 2014, the internet was rocked by what security researchers are calling a “catastrophically bad” bug. Known by the dramatic name Heartbleed, the bug left the widely-used, open source OpenSSL protocol vulnerable to attacks that could put servers’ private encryption keys into the hands of hackers. Major sites like Yahoo, Imgur, Flickr, LastPass, and countless others were left vulnerable, and, worst of all, the bug’s been in the code for years. In the immediate aftermath, admins are scrambling to protect their sites while more details on the bug come out, and the whole affair raises questions about the fragile state of security on the web. We’ll be tracking all that news and more right here.

How Big Tech is swallowing the AI industry
articles.summary: Amazon has replicated an antitrust-avoidance playbook pioneered by Microsoft with its hiring of most of the team behind buzzy AI startup Adept.
articles.body_text: A couple of months ago, I was sitting in the audience at a tech conference in San Fransisco watching Bloomberg’s Emily Chang interview Reid Hoffman. She asked about Microsoft’s hiring of the team behind Inflection, a would-be OpenAI competitor that Hoffman co-founded. It was an acquisition in everything but name, clearly designed to avoid the scrutiny of antitrust regulators. Not only had Microsoft (where Hoffman is a board member) hired most of Inflection’s employees — it also licensed the startup’s technology in a way that seemed designed to make its investors whole. Speaking with Chang that day onstage, Hoffman predicted that what happened to Inflection will become a “pattern” for future AI deals. We are seeing that pattern play out now. Last Friday, Amazon announced that it is hiring most of the team behind Adept, another would-be OpenAI competitor that raised about $400 million from top-tier investors to build, in the words of CEO David Luan, “a new type of giant model that turns natural language into actions on your machine.” Alexandra Miller, an Amazon spokesperson, told The Verge that the company had hired “close to” to 66 percent of Adept’s employees. In an internal memo published by GeekWire’s Taylor Soper, SVP Rohit Prasad said that, like Microsoft with Inflection, Amazon will also be licensing Adept’s technology to “accelerate our roadmap for building digital agents that can automate software workflows.” Adept’s corporate blog post about the news suggests it was running out of money: “Continuing with Adept’s initial plan of building both useful general intelligence and an enterprise agent product would’ve required spending significant attention on fundraising for our foundation models, rather than bringing to life our agent vision.” Recent reports say the company has been looking to sell itself. The reality is that building leading AI models is extremely costly, and raising $400 million isn’t even enough to compete these days. Big Tech, meanwhile, is flush with cash and looking to get in on what everyone perceives to be the next big thing. It’s logical for more AI startups to go the way of Inflection and Adept as the industry consolidates. The problem for Big Tech is that they are no longer allowed to buy companies like they once did. The current antitrust enforcement regime would most certainly try to block an Amazon acquisition of Adept, whether there is a strong legal argument for doing so or not. (Amazon execs are still seething about not being allowed to buy a robot vacuum cleaner company.) Even still, capitalism finds a way. What Microsoft did to Inflection, and what Amazon just did to Adept, is the new Big Tech playbook for swallowing the AI industry and getting away with it. Silicon Valley has a storied history of acquihires, where a startup is gutted for its people and left for dead. Microsoft and Amazon have done what are essentially reverse acquihires, where the hiring of people and a corresponding licensing deal is designed to disguise what is actually an acquisition. Reid Hoffman, meanwhile, should probably be congratulated for more than just an accurate prediction about the future of these deals — one of Adept’s earliest investors was none other than his venture capital firm, Greylock. Correction, July 1st: A previous version of this story incorrectly stated the percentage of Adept employees hired by Amazon. The percentage is “close to” 66 percent, not 80 percent.

articles.title: Moderat ”kupp” ger miljonstöd till SD i Stockholm
articles.summary: M, KD, C och L i Stockholms stad var överens om hur de skulle fördela resurserna som opposition. Trodde de.
articles.body_text: M, KD, C och L i Stockholms stad var överens om hur de skulle fördela resurserna som opposition. Trodde de. När avtalet skulle undertecknas visade det sig att M fört hemliga förhandlingar med SD – som nu får ett extra stöd värt flera miljoner kronor. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. I Stockholms stadshus dog inte alliansen. Moderaterna, Kristdemokraterna, Centerpartiet och Liberalerna håller fortfarande ihop, medan Sverigedemokraterna står utanför samarbetet. SD i Stockholm har genom åren präglats av både interna konflikter och avhopp. Inför valet lyftes röster om att släppa in SD men då sa Centerpartiet nej. Men efter att de rödgröna vann valet och bildade ett nytt styre har de fem partierna för första gången gått ihop för att fördela resurser och maximera det gemensamma inflytandet i opposition. Tjugo minuter innan kommunfullmäktiges sammanträde var det sagt att partierna skulle signera en överenskommelse för mandatperioden 2026-2030. Där regleras hur mycket pengar man får till sina respektive partikassor och kanslier. Alliansen hade förhandlat i flera veckor och till slut landat i ett kostnadsförslag. Men när det var dags att skriva under upptäcker de andra partierna att Moderaterna haft en hemlig sidoförhandling med Sverigedemokraterna. Det presenterades av M-toppen Christofer Fjellner utan förvarning, beskriver källor.

articles.body_text: Socialdemokraterna tappar greppet om norr. Partiet rasar 13,1 procentenheter i Boden och 13,0 i Dorotea – och gör ett katastrofval i Överkalix och Åsele. I Kramfors förlorar man över hälften av sina mandat. – Vi har nog inte sett botten än, säger statsvetaren Simon Matti. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. ■ S tappar kraftigt i Norrland och backar i kommunvalet i 45 av 54 kommuner. ■ I Överkalix var raset störst, med 25,7 procentenheter. Även i regionvalet och riksdagsvalet tappar S i norra Sverige – där partiet traditionellt sett har haft ett starkt fäste. ■ Statsvetaren tror att S grepp om norr kan fortsätta att försvagas flera val framåt. I årets kommunval backar Socialdemokraterna i 45 av de 54 norrländska kommunerna. Det rör sig om allt från tapp på en knapp procentenhet – till katastrofval med ras på som mest 25,7 procentenheter i Överkalix. Och i riksdagsvalet tappar S i alla Norrlandskommuner. Därmed är trenden ett faktum: partiets dominans i norr glider dem ur händerna. – I hela Norrland har de haft ett betydande grepp om makten. Det är klart att det finns undantag i någon kommun här och där, men i Västernorrland, Västerbotten och Norrbotten har man varit otroligt starka, säger Simon Matti, professor i statsvetenskap vid Luleå tekniska universitet.

articles.title: Razzia mot högernationalister i EU – misstänks ha förskingrat miljoner
articles.summary: Polis och EU-åklagare har gjort en razzia på flera kontor i Europaparlamentet, rapporterar den europeiska nyhetssajten Rapporteur. Tillslaget sker efter att anställda hos högernationalistiska Patriots misstänks ha förskingrat flera miljoner euro i bidrag.
articles.body_text: Polis och EU-åklagare har gjort en razzia på flera kontor i Europaparlamentet, rapporterar den europeiska nyhetssajten Rapporteur . Tillslaget sker efter att anställda hos högernationalistiska Patriots misstänks ha förskingrat flera miljoner euro i bidrag. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Polis och åklagare gjorde på onsdagsförmiddagen en razzia mot kontor tillhörande anställda på den högernationalistiska partigruppen Patriots for Europe i EU-parlamentet , skriver flera europeiska medier. Åklagarna kommer från den Europeiska åklagarmyndigheten och de utreder anklagelser om att den tidigare partigruppen ID förskingrat 4,3 miljoner euro, motsvarande mer än 47 miljoner kronor, i EU-bidrag. De misstänks ha slussat pengar till lokala partiavdelningar och tilldelat upphandlingar till partivänliga företag, enligt Politico . ” Medan Frankrikes gator håller på att urarta i kaos, verkar myndigheternas prioritet vara detta. Ingen bör låta sig luras av sådana trakasserier ”, skriver Jean-Paul Garraud, ledare för Nationell samling i EU-parlamentet, på X. Oegentligheterna uppdagades när partigruppen ID avvecklades 2024 och till delar blev Patriot. Det kontor som genomsöktes på onsdagsmorgonen tillhör Philip Claeys, tidigare generalsekreterare för ID, som nu innehar samma post hos Patriots. Enligt en tjänsteman förhördes han av EPPO, rapporterar Rapporteur. Genomsökningar genomfördes även i parlamentet i Bryssel. EU-parlamentet har tidigare utrett misstänkt fusk med EU-bidrag, kopplat till gruppen Patriots. 2025 beordrade parlamentets finansdepartement att de skulle betala tillbaka 276 000 euro, som de menar att partigruppen missbrukat i samband med liknande anklagelser. Då anklagade Patriots parlamentet för att bedriva en ”grundlös häxjakt” och menade att gruppen inte gjort något fel. Detta är en nyhetsartikel. articles.title: SD-topp anmäler S för grovt förtal
articles.summary: SD-toppen Gustav Gellerbrant anmäler Socialdemokraterna för grovt förtal för partiets inlägg i sociala medier om hans påstådda kopplingar till rysk underrättelsesfären genom sin sambo. S säger att man utgått från uppgifter i media.
articles.body_text: SD-toppen Gustav Gellerbrant anmäler Socialdemokraterna för grovt förtal för partiets inlägg i sociala medier om hans påstådda kopplingar till rysk underrättelsesfären genom sin sambo. S säger att man utgått från uppgifter i media. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Strax före valet avslöjade tidningen Expo att SD-toppen Gustav Gellerbrants sambo, som är tjänsteman för Sverigedemokraterna i riksdagen, under flera år hade spridit proryska budskap i sociala medier. Efter avslöjandet gick Gellerbrant på föräldraledighet och har kallat medierapporteringen för ”en omänsklig påfrestning för min familj”. Socialdemokraterna delade ett inlägg i sociala medier om händelsen, där partiet gjorde ett fiktivt CV över Gustav Gellerbrant, där det till exempel står ”2026 - avslöjades ha koppling till ryska underrättelsesfären genom sin sambo, också politisk sekreterare för SD i riksdagen”. Det är det inlägget som Gellerbrant nu polisanmält. – Vi menar på att det Socialdemokratiska Arbetarpartiet har, genom publiceringen av de här anklagelserna mot Gustav, begått ett förtalsbrott, säger Iman Bayazi, juridiskt ombud. – Inlägget kan, i princip, likställas med ett icke-sant brottsregister. Och det gjorde de bara några dagar innan valet 2026. – Inlägget fick ju en sån enorm spridning och delades av andra och så vidare. Så att det är ungefär där domstolarna brukar titta på om det var förtal eller grovt förtal, så att säga. Det är ju faktiskt några av de absolut viktigaste omständigheterna, hur stor spridning detta fick. – Och Socialdemokraterna med sina 80 000 plus-medlemmar och 10 000-tals medlemmar på Facebook , de har ju en enorm makt att sprida saker och ting. Så det är det vi menar gränsar till grovt förtal. Socialdemokraternas presstjänst skriver i en kommentar till Expressen att partiet inväntar stämningsansökan och ska analysera den.

articles.title: Trump: ”Skedde av respekt för Trump”
articles.summary: Amerikanska medborgaren Stephen Hubbard släpptes av Ryssland ”av respekt för Trump”, skriver Trump. Samtidigt säger presidenten att det berodde på lättade sanktioner.
articles.body_text: Amerikanen Stephen Hubbard släpptes av Ryssland utan amerikanska eftergifter. Samtidigt pekar presidenten ut en annan anledning till frigivningen. ”Om sanktioner hade införts skulle dessa förhandlingar med säkerhet ha avbrutits helt och hållet”, skriver han. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Den 74-årige amerikanen Stephen Hubbard greps av ryska styrkor i ockuperade delar av Ukraina 2022. Han anklagades av Kreml för att ha stridit för Ukraina – åtalspunkter som USA :s utrikesdepartement ansåg var falska. Trump säger att Ryssland släppte amerikanen Stephen Hubbard ”av respekt för Trump” – utan fångutbyte. Samtidigt medger han att lättade sanktioner spelade roll. De dubbla beskeden väcker frågor om spelet mellan USA, Ryssland och Ukraina. Under onsdagen släpptes Hubbard plötsligt. Det skedde samtidigt som USA:s särskilda sändebud Steve Witkoff var i Ryssland för att förhandla om nya samtal med Ukraina. Witkoff beskrev Vladimir Putin som ”en människovän” för hans beslut att släppa Hubbard, skriver CNN. Men spelet bakom frisläppningen framstår oklart från president Donald Trumps egna inlägg i sociala medier. Trump skriver att Ryssland släppt Hubbard efter ett telefonsamtal med Putin förra veckan, där Trump uttryckligen bad om att Hubbard skulle få komma hem.

articles.title: Putins man om kriget i Ukraina: ”Närmar sig slutet”
articles.summary: Vladimir Putin har gett grönt ljus för att väcka nytt liv i trilaterala förhandlingar med Ukraina och Ryssland. Kreml föreslår att samtalen ska hållas i Abu Dhabi. – Konflikten i Ukraina närmar sig slutet, säger president rådgivaren Jurij Usjakov.
articles.body_text: Vladimir Putin har gett grönt ljus för att väcka nytt liv i trilaterala förhandlingar med Ukraina och Ryssland. Kreml föreslår att samtalen ska hållas i Abu Dhabi. – Konflikten i Ukraina närmar sig slutet, säger president rådgivaren Jurij Usjakov. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Under dagen har Donald Trumps sändebud till Ukrainakriget, hans nära vän Steve Witkoff, suttit i ett tre timmar långt samtal med Rysslands president Vladimir Putin, rapporterar ryska nyhetsbyråer. Förutom att släppa den pensionerade amerikanske läraren Stephen Hubbard, 74, som suttit fängslad i Ryssland sedan 2022, anklagad för att ha stridit som legosoldat för Ukraina, så tycks mötet ha resulterat i en förhandlingsöppning kring Ukrainakriget. Efter att under lång tid ha vägrat att förhandla med Ukraina uppges den ryske presidenten nu ha godkänt trilaterala förhandlingar med landet och USA. – Konflikten i Ukraina närmar sig slutet, säger Putins topprådgivare Jurij Usjakov, rapporterar Dagbladet med hänvisning till ryska nyhetsbyrån Tass. Kreml har även föreslagit att sådana fredssamtal skulle kunna hållas i Abu Dhabi, i Förenade Arabemiraten, i slutet av november. Ukraina har ännu inte kommenterat planerna på trilaterala samtal. Under den senaste veckan har Zelenskyj tagit bladet från munnen gällande Donald Trump, och uppgett att han känner sig ”förråd” av den amerikanske presidenten efter att denne lanserat ett miljardavtal med Putin gällande import av rysk dieselolja. Zelenskyj har även anklagat presidentadministrationen för att under förra veckan ha dragit in tidiga varningar för inkommande ryska attacker. Vilket resulterade i att Ukraina fick svårt att försvara sig när Ryssland utförde storskaliga robot- och drönarattacker mot ukrainsk energiinfrastruktur – med dödsoffer och omfattande strömavbrott som följd.

articles.summary: Vänsterpartiet säger att Muhammed Ali måste få fullfölja sitt demokratiska uppdrag. Men i riksdagen syns han inte till – och frågetecknen är många. Här är frågorna han vägrar svara på.
articles.body_text: Vänsterpartiet säger att Muhammed Ali måste få fullfölja sitt demokratiska uppdrag. Men i riksdagen syns han inte till – och frågetecknen är många. Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Grunden till beslutet var att han inte ansågs ha ett hederligt leverne. Men efter det har han inte svarat på några frågor. Under en månads tid har vi sökt svar. I lördags lovade han att återkomma, men sedan dess har han gått under jorden. Hans stol i riksdagens kammare står tom. Vänsterpartiets partisekreterare Maria Forsberg uppger att Mohamed Ali kommer att tillträda sitt uppdrag ”inom kort”. – Så länge Mohamed Ali inte är delgiven misstanke för något brott så måste han få möjlighet att visa att han vill fullfölja sitt demokratiska uppdrag och betala sina skulder, säger hon.

articles.title: Lind om FN:s klimatlarm: ”Får inte tappa hoppet”
articles.summary: 1,5-gradersmålet kört, enligt FN • SD: ”Enorm osäkerhet”
articles.body_text: Parisavtalets klimatmål är kört – nu går vi mot 2,8 graders uppvärmning, enligt FN. – Vi får inte tappa hoppet, säger Amanda Lind (MP). – Det finns en enorm osäkerhet här, säger Martin Kinnunen (SD). Ljuduppspelningen är AI-genererad. Felaktigheter kan förekomma. Världen kan omöjligt klara Parisavtalets mål om att begränsa den globala uppvärmningen till 1,5 grader. Det slår en ny rapport från FN:s miljöprogram Unep fast. Med dagens klimatpolitik riskerar uppvärmningen i stället att nå 2,8 grader. Särskilt illa beskrivs utvecklingen i USA, där Donald Trump lämnat Parisavtalet och utsläppen ökat mer än i något annat land. För att stoppa de värsta konsekvenserna krävs bland annat massiv koldioxidlagring, en teknik som fortfarande inte finns i stor skala. Miljöpartiets språkrör Amanda Lind tycker att rapporten visar på situationens allvar. Men i stället för att tappa hoppet måste politikerna börja agera nu, menar hon. – FN pekar på viktiga åtgärder att ta tag i här och nu, som att bygga ut den förnybara energin, satsa på energieffektivisering och fasa ut det fossila. Det vill vi komma i gång med på en gång, säger Lind. Enligt Amanda Lind visar rapporten att det är bråttom att få en ny regering i Sverige. – Den här rapporten visar tydligt varför regeringsbildningen måste gå snabbare. Efter fyra förlorade år för klimatet med Tidöregeringen så måste Sverige upp på banan igen, säger hon. Martin Kinnunen , klimatpolitisk talesperson för Sverigedemokraterna, tycker inte att rapporten kommer som en överraskning. Han ser inte heller kopplingen till den svenska regeringsbildningen. – Jag har väldigt svårt att se en koppling mellan Uneps rapport och svensk regeringsbildning. Men jag håller med om att det vore ju önskvärt att det gick snabbare, säger han.
